item.description: Love Athletica is opening a luxe new beachside pilates studio, complete with high-energy workouts, premium amenities and a launch celebration packed with prizes and perks.

item.title: South Australians urged to have final say on large-scale puppy farm bans
item.description: South Australians have hours left to help shape a strict new breeder licensing scheme designed to support a statewide puppy farm ban and strengthen animal welfare protections.

item.title: SA backs national push to make Health Star Ratings mandatory on packaged foods
